records.canonicalQuestion: Why did Visual-Asset-Engine git pull fail with diverging branches?
alternateQuestions: How to reconcile a repo that cannot fast-forward during estate pull?
records.shortAnswer: Visual-Asset-Engine main has local commits diverged from origin/main; ff-only pull aborts; operator must merge or rebase after reviewing dirty state.
records.detailedAnswer: Estate pull FAIL — diverged main cannot fast-forward

futureAgentInstructions.whenThisAppears: git pull --ff-only fails with 'diverging branches' or 'Not possible to fast-forward'
doNot: Silently skip diverged repo in estate pull summary
proveBeforeClaiming: git merge origin/main OR git rebase origin/main completes
git status clean or dirty state explicitly reported

records.canonicalQuestion: Why did CapitalGlass-Documents git pull fail with no tracking information?
alternateQuestions: How to fix git pull when branch has no upstream?
records.shortAnswer: CapitalGlass-Documents on work/document-center-adaptive-details-panel-v1-clean failed pull because no @{u} is set; set upstream or pull explicit remote branch.
records.detailedAnswer: Estate pull FAIL — feature branch without upstream tracking

futureAgentInstructions.whenThisAppears: git pull fails with 'no tracking information for the current branch'
doNot: Assume main is checked out on every repo
Mark estate pull PASS while any repo FAIL remains
proveBeforeClaiming: git pull origin <branch> succeeds OR upstream set and ff-only pull passes

records.canonicalQuestion: How do I git pull all Capital Glass repos on WESLEY_WORK WSL?
alternateQuestions: What is the canonical repos root for estate git pull?
Why does estate git pull use --ff-only?
records.shortAnswer: Pull all Capital Glass repos from canonical WSL ext4 root with git pull --ff-only; report OK/FAIL/DIRTY per repo; never force-pull diverged branches.
records.detailedAnswer: WSL estate-wide git pull — ff-only loop on /home/wesley/repos

futureAgentInstructions.whenThisAppears: Operator asks to sync or pull all repos on WSL
runPreflight: List repos: for d in /home/wesley/repos/*/; test -d "$d/.git" && basename "$d"
doNot: Use C:\Developer\repos or NTFS paths for bulk pull on WESLEY_WORK
Force pull or reset diverged repos without operator approval
Skip reporting FAIL and DIRTY repos
proveBeforeClaiming: Per-repo exit code from git pull --ff-only
